title: LuckReport
description: The four numbers of the Ruthless Luck Algorithm (spec v1.6, section 2 step 8) for one agent and one scoring window. Luck is derived as outcome - price; if present it must equal that difference. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (horizon > t; an absorbed path is scored at ruin_value; numbers must be finite; ruin_mass 0 with an absorbed path, or 1 with a surviving path, falsifies the model) are enforced by LuckReport.from_dict in the reference implementation.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model that produced the price. Luck against an unnamed model cannot be audited.

t.description: Time at which the price was set.

horizon.description: Scoring time T; must exceed t.

price.description: E_{i,t}[Y_T], absorbed paths included at ruin_value.

outcome.description: Realized Y_T; equals ruin_value if the path was absorbed.

ruin_value.description: y_R, the yield assigned to absorbed paths.

luck.description: Optional; must equal outcome - price exactly (IEEE-754 double subtraction).
